attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to gain access to an account secured with MFA.
description: An abnormally high amount of SSO authentication attempts were seen within a short period of time. This could be the outcome of a brute-force login attempt.
investigative_actions: Check the legitimacy of this activity and determine whether it is malicious or not. Check whether a successful login was made after unsuccessful attempts.
name: Intense SSO failures
